title: Family-Scoped Validation Simplification & Zombie Retirement
objective: Reduce the live development execution surface to one family-scoped application CI path and one flattened AIOC health path; retire historical validators from automatic execution; replace repeated predecessor revalidation with sealed proof ancestry; prevent concurrent feature starts during control-plane maintenance; and make future family transitions explicitly establish their allowed validation surface once per family rather than once per tranche.

convergence_control.last_failure_signature: MV-CONT-007 stopped after app PR 336 and the AIOC start/lock PR 777 merged; AIOC still executed RSR-01..07 and the historical repository-health version chain while lifecycle/runtime registries remained stale.
diagnostic_hypotheses: Cross-repository maintenance was modeled as separate merges without a machine-enforced atomic closeout transaction.
The lifecycle registry declared historical validators inert but the current workflow and current validator did not enforce that declaration against their own execution paths.
Textual continuation guidance lacked an executable final-response termination preflight, allowing an intermediate merge to become a conversation stopping point.

changed_since_previous: Owner explicitly approved completing MV-CONT-007 and preventive hardening.
Both repositories were refreshed from exact live main heads and the completed app half was verified at e34d43d669c48d484dbdb9e82b72a00c5d91f00c.
A fresh AIOC recovery branch was created from cd8f5391780aa3d7e5a81672d6bef286bd0d353e instead of reusing the merged start branch.
The repair now treats flat validation, registry reconciliation, zombie retirement and behavioral termination enforcement as one bounded closeout.

known_defects: AIOC live Repository Health executes RSR-01..07 validators even though validator lifecycle registry classifies historical validate_*.py scripts inert.
AIOC repository-health entrypoint inherits a long version chain rather than a flat current validator surface.
Application Repository Health and current-tranche validation are separate automatic workflows despite overlapping exact-head/execution-surface checks.
AAI profiles rerun all historical AAI predecessor verifiers on both lanes even when completed proof has not been invalidated.
No canonical exclusive maintenance lease prevents another conversation from governed-starting selected feature work while control-plane remediation is active.
completion_gate: Application ordinary PR validation has one automatic family-scoped workflow path.
Historical predecessor proof is sealed and checked by ancestry/integrity rather than rerun by default.
AIOC live workflow no longer directly runs RSR-01..07 historical validators.
Current AIOC repository health is flattened to one current validator implementation surface without version-chain runtime imports.
Family contract switches allowed validation scope only at family boundaries or explicit exceptional integration tranches.
Repository health machine-enforces active-family scope and retired-validator nonexecution.
Exact-head validation passes in both repositories and remediation merges before AAI-10 governed start.
active_operation: Flatten the current AIOC health path, enforce lifecycle and termination contracts, reconcile live registries to the completed app half, retire superseded PR paths, and complete exact-head closeout.
next_action: Implement and validate the bounded AIOC recovery on codex/mv-cont-007-recovery; merge after exact-head health passes, close superseded PRs, clear the maintenance lease, and return canonical selection to AAI-10 selected_not_started.
